mapper.select: /* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveRsltByHourList */ SELECT TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24') || '00' AS TIME, NVL(MAX(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT), 0) AS WTNG_PSG_CNT, NVL(SUM(A.TRNST_PSG_CNT), 0) AS TRNST_PSG_CNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)), 0) AS WTNG_HR, NVL(ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_PRCS_HR)), 0) AS PRCS_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24') ORDER BY TIME

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrievePsgPrcsGradeList */ SELECT A.FCLT_GROUP_CD, A.PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD, A.MIN_VL, A.MAX_VL FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_PSG_PRCS_GRD A WHERE A.FCLT_GROUP_CD = #{fcltGroupCd} ORDER BY A.PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveScrtyOpenCountList */ SELECT A.GATE_NO AS UNIT_CD, COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, MAX(A.FCLTY_CNT) AS OPR_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB A WHERE A.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE( #{scrtyCntrlRsrcId}, 'FOTSC|FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl', '' ) AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} GROUP BY A.GATE_NO ORDER BY UNIT_CD

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveFcltUnitList */
SELECT CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CC', 'CK', 'SBD') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('SC', 'SR') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 5, 1) ELSE ' ' END AS UNIT_CD, COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN B.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS OPR_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CC', 'CK', 'SBD') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('SC', 'SR') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 5, 1) ELSE ' ' END ORDER BY UNIT_CD

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveWeather */
SELECT NVL(MAX(A.WTHR_CN) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '') AS WTHR_CN, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.MAX_TP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS MAX_TP, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.MIN_TP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS MIN_TP, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.HMDT_VL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS HMDT_VL, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.WS_VL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS WS_VL, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.RWY_ATM) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS RWY_ATM FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_WTHCN_INFO A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.CRT_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.CTY_NM = '인천'
